definitions.healthy: classification: accuracy and task-specific F1 exceed majority baseline by >= 0.05; sentence regression: Pearson and Spearman >= 0.3
definitions.collapsed_signature: classification accuracy/task-specific F1 match a constant-class baseline; not prediction-level proof
definitions.weak: other finite outcomes; zero correlation does not prove regression collapse
definitions.supported: at least 3 observations, >= 50% healthy and <= 25% collapsed signatures
definitions.limitations: completed runs only; historical benchmarks informed calibration; no causal optimizer comparisons
